body.name: graph-sensitive unconditional effective total degree schedule
body.construction: Given an acyclic mixed graph \(G=(V_n,D,B)\), compute \(\mathfrak B(G)\), run \(\operatorname{DBI}(G,\mathfrak B(G))\) once through its complete internal weighted-degree loop, disable finite wall-clock timeouts, and retain the exact identifying formulas or the complete exact bounded-search certificate.  On the directed-indegree-two input domain, the graph-independent alternative replaces \(\mathfrak B(G)\) by \(B_2(n)=U_2(n)\).
